prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE beautifully art-directed concept image for a contemporary premium 2D PIXEL ART tavern management browser game. This is a MODERN fresh sophisticated art direction, not a medieval fantasy tavern. Landscape 3:2 composition. Strict flat orthographic overhead classic 2D management-game camera with visible front edges of furniture, consistent top-down tile geometry. NEVER isometric, NEVER 3D, NEVER a perspective architectural render. Deliberate visible square pixel clusters, clean controlled pixel density as if a carefully crafted 640x400 game canvas enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Sharp pixel edges with stepped shadows, no smooth vector illustration, no painterly brushwork, no heavy textures. Elevated restrained designed lighting is the main storytelling tool. High visual hierarchy, room to breathe, furniture silhouettes readable at game scale. A complete inviting working tavern interior with bar across northern third, kitchen/prep room at upper right behind glass partition, compact stockroom upper left, six small dining tables in left and right clusters, clear central walkway to entrance centered at south, a bartender, server and a few stylish adult patrons. Contemporary beer taps, bottles, elegant tankards, plated food, discreet storage, recognizable tavern management activity. Modern electric and architectural lighting. No medieval architecture, no rough dungeon stones, no candles, no torches, no rustic barrel clutter, no ornate medieval UI frames. No interface panels, no captions, no branding, no watermark. Single complete scene, not a collage. DIRECTION A: MOONLIT GALLERY. A restrained contemporary boutique-hotel tavern designed like an intimate art gallery. Deep inky midnight blue structural walls, pale stone microcement central floor and rich walnut floor zones, sculptural walnut bar counter with brushed champagne brass accents, cream upholstered chairs and very few curated objects. Large north-west picture window opens to a calm dark blue night landscape. Strong beautifully composed shafts of cold blue moonlight cross the central walkway as discrete sharply stepped pixel shapes, contrasted against warm honey pools of light above each table. Minimal horizontal pendant lights and slender luminous brass rings over bar, thin amber recessed strip along bar plinth and shelf edges. Dark to bright cinematographic composition but all play zones readable. Tiny pinprick reflections on polished glass and metal. Atmosphere feels hushed, exclusive, refined, architectural, new; a warm refuge within a moonlit contemporary space. Palette 60% midnight/graphite, 25% walnut/warm cream, 15% amber and ice blue. Clear graphic shapes rather than excessive material detail. Maintain a strict top-down game-map design.
